name: Overturn Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services of the Department of Health and Human Services rule: Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, HHS Notice of Benefit and Payment Parameters for 2027; and Basic Health Program
official: A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services of the Department of Health and Human Services relating to "Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, HHS Notice of Benefit and Payment Parameters for 2027; and Basic Health Program".

timeline.text: Motion to proceed to consideration of measure rejected in Senate by Yea-Nay Vote. 48 - 51. Record Vote Number: 251. (consideration: CR S5139-5140)
timeline.label: Motion to proceed
timeline.explain: Vote to begin debating the measure. Not passage.

timeline.text: Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 456.
timeline.label: Placed on the calendar

timeline.text: Senate Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions discharged, by petition, pursuant to 5 U.S.C. 802(c).
timeline.label: Update

timeline.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.
timeline.label: Introduced / sent to committee
